lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Posterior to the final gill slit, a series of vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible. The first distinct column contains three primary spots, followed by subsequent columns of similar vertical arrangement forming a semi-regular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, connecting the primary blobs in vertical alignments to form a grid-like structural pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp contrast between lighter pixels on the superior edge and a subtle shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-intensity white pixel clusters compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the mid-flank.
